name: YOLO full port (HIGH RISK)
description: HIGH RISK, PAPER only. One early-momentum entry at a time, the biggest size the paper book allows behind it. Holder-safety gates first: LP burned or locked, no mint or freeze authority, the LARP check, minimum liquidity. Take the cost back at about 2x, then a free bag with a loose trail; thesis-break and liquidity-pull exits, a time stop, never the same coin twice. Most entries lose and one rug can zero the wallet.

profiles.name: YOLO (cost back at 2x, free bag)
profiles.description: The whole stake on one young pair. At about 2x, sell the slice that pays back the position cost; the rest rides as a free bag on a loose 50% trail. Liquidity pulls, dev sells and dead volume exit at once; a -50% stop and a 45-minute time stop keep a full-port position from bleeding out slowly.

fit.summary: A young pair (0-2 h) with LP burned or locked, no mint or freeze authority, a LARP score below the high band, liquidity >= $25k and a first clean 5-minute push.
signals: first clean 5m push with buyers ahead of sellers
many distinct buyers, top-2 share low

hardStop.why: The whole wallet rides on one coin: a -50% stop ends a slow bleed. A rug or a pulled pool still fills near -100%, whatever the stop says.

reentry.requires: never the same coin twice: a full-port entry is never repeated

notes: The bag trail arms on the cost-recovery sell; before that the stop, the time stop, the thesis breaks and the rug floor exit.
An agent can tighten or exit early, never loosen a stop or a trail.
HIGH RISK. Paper only: dexterm holds no key and places no live order. Experimental; not financial advice. Self-directed only.
Paper: the runner's book caps one position at 25% (the ceiling for every strategy); the replay below measures full port.
Run it: `dexterm autotrade run yolo --paper` (`--replay builtin:yolo-rehearsal --stub` for a short fixture run).
`dexterm autotrade yolo-replay yolo` shows what full-port compounding did on your recorded history: rugs, the loss spread and how often it zeroed the wallet.
